title: Scars of Mirrodin/Intro packs
description: MTG Wiki (Category:Scars of Mirrodin block intro packs)

paragraphs.text: Scars of Mirrodin features five intro packs , one of which is monocolored and four are bicolored.
Deadspread is a blue / black intro pack featuring proliferate with -1/-1 counters and charge counters.
1 Sorcerer's Strongbox
1 Trigon of Corruption
The rares in this deck are Carnifex Demon (holographic foil) and Contagion Engine .
Metalcraft is a red / blue intro pack featuring the ability of the same name .
2 Blade-Tribe Berserkers
The rares in this deck are Argent Sphinx (holographic foil) and Etched Champion .
Myr of Mirrodin is a white intro pack centered around artifacts, specifically the Myr .
2 Seize the Initiative
The rares in this deck are Sunblast Angel (holographic foil) and Myr Battlesphere .
Phyrexian Poison is a black / green intro pack centered around infect .
1 Hand of the Praetors
1 Rise from the Grave
The rares in this deck are Putrefax (holographic foil) and Hand of the Praetors .
Relic Breaker is a red / green intro pack with an anti-artifact theme.
1 Hoard-Smelter Dragon
1 Prodigal Pyromancer
2 Vulshok Heartstoker
The rares in this deck are Hoard-Smelter Dragon (holographic foil) and Asceticism .
